messages:
maria_cs: Flagging Halcyon — 40% seat activity drop over 2 weeks. Renewal ~6w. Their CTO (our champion) left; new data lead onboarded last week. Concerned about churn. :warning:
jamal_csm: ouch. any notes on whether the new data lead has been briefed?
tyler_ae: they rescheduled our follow-up and mentioned a vendor POC (LumenAI). haven't had the new lead on a call yet.
olivia_sales: LumenAI is on our radar (cheaper embedding infra). i'll check my contact to see if pilot moved beyond exploration.
maria_cs: quick metrics 30d:
- seats: 44 -> 26
- api/day: 13k -> 7.8k
- avg tokens/session: 340 -> 210
ops-bot: Reminder: renewal_due=2026-05-14, enterprise_support=true.
jamal_csm: hypothesis: lost advocate + exploratory pilot + possible deploy regression. recommend immediate triage: re-onboard + health audit.
tyler_ae: proposed steps: 1) 30-min intro with new data lead this week; 2) health-check (failing routes + perf trends); 3) offer 2-week concierge SE support to unblock migration.
maria_cs: action owners: @tyler_ae schedule call (target Thu), @olivia_sales confirm LumenAI pilot status (EOD), @jamal_csm assemble health artifacts. i'll draft a re-engage note to send once call confirmed.
olivia_sales: checking with rep now. will report back. :mag_right:
tyler_ae: tentatively booked Thu 10am PT; sending invite with short agenda: quick tour, pain points, migration blockers.
jamal_csm: upload checklist to invite: sample dropped requests, error types, perf delta graphs, ROI snapshot.
maria_cs: quick note: if pricing is raised we can offer time-limited seat credit or rate concession with commit — prefer to remediate ops issues first.
ops-bot: NOTE: deploy 2026-04-02-824 changed batching defaults for halcyon-org; correlate with start of drop.
tyler_ae: that aligns with the timeline. tagging eng-runtime in follow-up.
olivia_sales: update: rep says pilot is exploratory; dataset ingest incomplete. good runway to re-engage.
maria_cs: priorities: 1) verify deploy impact with eng-runtime, 2) call with new data lead, 3) competitive intel from olivia. who will own internal 'save' playbook?
jamal_csm: i'll own the playbook + health-check. draft by tomorrow noon.
tyler_ae: i'll own the re-engage note and present migration options.
maria_cs: thanks — keeping updates in this thread. if deploy is causal i'll escalate to eng-runtime for urgent patch/rollback. :white_check_mark:
